description: This file defines a class 'Operations' containing mathematical functions such as mod, power, product, and quotient, used for spreadsheet calculations in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: A class providing static methods for mathematical operations used in spreadsheet calculations, including mod, power, product, and quotient.

methods.name: mod
methods.description: Calculates the mathematical modulus of two numbers, handling array inputs for spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: power
methods.description: Calculates x raised to the power y, with support for array inputs and error handling.

methods.name: product
methods.description: Returns the product of multiple values or cell references, with error handling.

methods.name: quotient
methods.description: Returns the integer part of a division of numerator by denominator, with support for arrays and error handling.
